scope: First PR10 shared control batch, Single Box then Jenga Stack sample selector. Actual input on CPU,ordinary/native GPU,ordinary/native combined. No engine or solver edits.
diagnostic_storage: Keep compact action receipts/required original screenshots. Stream observer tail for each action; delete full observer log only after event windows/identity/flags checked. No binaries/cache copies/fullhealth.
cache_policy: Reuse prior cache_source directories without copying; record file count/bytes/digests before and after; preserve shared caches.
cleanup: Every exit releases held input and waits owned viewer; remove consumed observer logs after extraction, keep failure receipts. Stop first infra/control failure; no blind retries.
input: Owned X11 window only, XTEST via xdotool; coordinate clicks require latest reviewed screenshot hash and same world identity. Initial/stale screen never treated as pass.
acceptance: Numeric context/public-world flags and step/lifetime effects, actual displayed state/layout and sample shape switch; shared results do not certify all165 sample-specific inputs.
